name: Tioga Peaceful Valley Campground
note: City of Tioga campground at the east end of the Tioga Dam reservoir, up the hill behind the medical center: grass sites in a row along a tree belt beside the city dog park, set back across the campground's gravel loops from the shore. The nearest dump station is at Tioga Park Campground in town ($10 cash). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Tioga department page 'Tioga Peaceful Valley Campground- Tioga Dam' (tiogand.net/departments/tioga-peaceful-valley-campground-tioga-dam/, read 2026-11-12): 1130 N. Welo St, 'Up the hill behind Tioga Medical Center and Zion Lutheran Church'; '$20/night (Camper/RV or Tent)'; 'Electrical Only - Six sites, 30 & 50 amp options'; 'Toilets and potable water on-site - no showers'; reserve via the Tioga Community Center (701-664-3192 ext. 1) with a permit application at least two days ahead -> a city campground on the city's own page (public ladder step 1). The page's own photos: a 'TIOGA PEACEFUL VALLEY CAMPGROUND RULES' sign ('FEES: $20 PER DAY FOR CAMPSITE WITH ELECTRICITY. RESERVE AND PAY IN ADVANCE AT TIOGA COMMUNITY CENTER') and three electric pedestals on open mown grass along a tree row with the dog-park chain-link fence beside them. ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025, hhs.nd.gov statewide-licensed-rv-parks-campgrounds-exception.pdf, read 2026-11-12) row 390: TIOGA PEACEFUL VALLEY CAMPSITE, 1130 N WELO ST, Tioga, Williams County, owner CITY OF TIOGA, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 7/10/2024, 6 lots. Imagery (Esri 2024-07-20; Wayback 2023-08-17 z18/z19, 2020-07-16): Welo St N (asphalt past the medical center, then gravel) leads to gravel loops at the reservoir's east end; the 2023 frame shows a camper-sized white unit parked on the strip along the north side of the tree belt just east of the fenced dog park, where the pedestals stand -> drive-in, open grass where a 23-ft rig fits; no length limit, road warning or 4WD wording anywhere. No horse facilities or mention. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule. Long-stay/workforce (Bakken area): only a nightly rate is published (no weekly/monthly rate), 6 sites, captures show 0-1 unit (2020 none, 2023 one, 2024 none visible) -> nightly 100%, not a workforce or residential park. Duplicate check 2026-11-12: campgrounds.json has only 6012 Tioga City Park within 15 km (0.81 km away) and no Peaceful Valley in ND; separate (see flags).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery 2024-07-20 (440 m frame at 48.4058,-102.9365; 1.8 km frame) and Wayback 2023-08-17 (z18 at 48.4061,-102.9355, z19 at 48.4061,-102.9360) and 2020-07-16 (z18). The six electric sites sit in a row along the north side of a tree belt east of the fenced dog park (city photo of the pedestals; the 2023 camper at 48.40562,-102.93548). The reservoir (Tioga Dam, ~65-80 acres) shore is ~95-100 m north, across the campground's gravel access road, its two gravel loops, a toilet building and a few trees on mown grass -> beyond the ~50 m bound with loop roads between, so not on-water; the lake is in open view across that open ground -> lakeview. Dam check: the embankment runs along the reservoir's south side west of the campground; USGS 3DEP 1 m transect north from the site row at -102.9358: 699.1 / 698.9 (row) / 698.7 / 698.0 / 697.1 / 696.5 / 696.3 m (water surface) - an even slope down to the water with no berm, the row ~2.5 m above pool; the ground below the embankment to the south-west is 693-694 m, so the campground is on the reservoir side above pool, not below the dam (Open-Meteo DEM 698 m at the pin).

booking.note: Reserve through the Tioga Community Center (10 am-5 pm Mon-Sat) and complete a permit application there at least two days before arrival; photo ID, 18+, RV insurance if applicable; pay by cash, card or check.

flags: Separate from 6012 Tioga City Park (not a duplicate), though only ~0.8 km apart: separate HHS licences (TIOGA CITY PARK, 312 NE 4 Street, owner TIOGA PARK BOARD, 14 lots, inspected 6/17/2024 vs TIOGA PEACEFUL VALLEY CAMPSITE, 1130 N Welo St, owner CITY OF TIOGA, 6 lots, inspected 7/10/2024), separate city directory listings, different operators, and separate access: 6012 is in the town park off 4th St NE south of the community center; this one is reached by Welo St N past the medical center and church to the reservoir's east end. The city page itself sends Peaceful Valley campers to the dump station 'at the Tioga Park Campground'.

For 6012: its note ('Reserve through Tioga Community Center') and booking {reservable, platform: operator} look borrowed from this campground - the Community Center reservation and permit procedure is published only for Peaceful Valley; Tioga Park Campground's city directory page gives only 701-641-1533 (park manager) and 'tenting all the way to motor homes and a bathhouse'. Its dump: true is confirmed by this page ('A dumping station is located at the Tioga Park Campground (south of the community center). $10 cash only'). HHS: TIOGA CITY PARK, owner TIOGA PARK BOARD, 14 lots.

No walk-ups: a permit application at the Community Center at least two days ahead is required (booking.fcfs never). The sign gives 701-664-3191, the city page 701-664-3192 ext. 1; the page's number is written.

Season not published (the 'mid-April until the snow flies' text on the city's recreation page is the golf course's) - left unwritten. No 2026 operating statement: the city's text still says 'The Tioga Dam Reconstruction Project will be starting in spring 2023' (its project link, cityoftioga.com/tioga-dam-project, 404s/times out); Moore Engineering says the north-shore trail phase was finished fall 2024 and phase 2 waits on a dam-safety project 'at a later time'. Last HHS inspection 7/10/2024. Phone-list candidate if AWH wants it: open in 2026, and is any dam-safety work closing the campground?
Toilet type (flush/vault) not written: the city says only 'Toilets'; imagery shows one small building on the loop near the shore.

No Google Maps listing of its own: searches for Peaceful Valley / Tioga Dam campground return Tioga Park Campgrounds (6012). ndtourism (never a source) says 'electric hook-ups for 4'; the city says six.
Pin: on the site row at the 2023 parked camper, north side of the tree belt east of the dog park; the exact span of the six pedestals is not published.
curation_note: ND lead 17 (2026-11-12): separate from 6012 (HHS TIOGA PEACEFUL VALLEY CAMPSITE, City of Tioga, 6 lots, inspected 7/10/2024, vs TIOGA CITY PARK, Tioga Park Board, 14 lots; ~0.8 km apart, separate access). Site row located from the city's pedestal photo (dog-park fence beside a tree row) and a camper on the 2023 Wayback frame. --Claude
